name: Verify Short Description and Description are generated from conversation
objective: Validate that when the AI creates a ticket, the Short Description and Description fields are auto-generated from the conversation content.
precondition: User is logged in, on home page, AI Assistant panel is open.

steps.description: Click the Agentforce icon and describe a detailed issue
steps.testData: "My laptop keeps showing blue screen errors whenever I open Outlook. It started 2 days ago after the Windows update."

steps.description: Complete the ticket creation flow and confirm
Verify the Short Description is generated from conversation
steps.expectedResult: Short Description contains a concise summary of the issue (e.g., 'Blue screen error when opening Outlook')

steps.description: Verify the full Description captures conversation details
steps.expectedResult: Description includes the detailed issue, context, and timeline from the conversation
